title: Store errors map to HTTP via mapStoreError
content: ERROR-HANDLING CONVENTION: store errors translate to HTTP status codes through ONE function, mapStoreError in main.go (404 ErrNotFound, 409 ErrConflict, 400 ErrInvalidID, 429 ErrUserAtCap, 500 default). Handlers never hand-code status numbers for store failures. New endpoints MUST call mapStoreError instead of adding inline status decisions.
